questions.question: Why did Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses?
options: Over his great age and his failing strength
Over his Cushite wife and his unique role
Over the way he led them in battle
Over the wealth he had gathered
questions.answer: Over his Cushite wife and his unique role

questions.question: What happened to Miriam as punishment?
God said he spoke to Moses face to face, not in riddles.
Miriam became _____, white as snow, for speaking against Moses.
